title: Stress-testing PAC robustness certificates under distribution shift

original_idea.body: Stress-testing PAC robustness certificates (arXiv:2512.20865) under controlled distribution shift on a small classifier; coverage check showing where the guarantee silently breaks.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Detecting silent certificate failure under shift is valuable but the chain to catastrophic AI risk is indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Small classifier + reproduced certificate + corruption shifts; some PAC/convex-program depth, but guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused coverage-check deliverable; reproducing the scenario convex program adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent stress test of a safety certificate, open models, lab-independent.

low_compute.reasoning: Small classifier and analytical certificate; modest compute.

novelty.reasoning: Recent certificate; distribution-shift stress test is a plausibly-open angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Certificate exists; shift-robustness check may be open.
